questions.question_english: The primary objective of an “Internal Audit” conducted by the government education department is to:

Permanently replace the Head of School with a certified Chartered Accountant from private practice
Evaluate and audit the pedagogical effectiveness and instructional quality of classroom teaching
Check compliance with financial rules and help rectify errors before external audit
questions.explanation_english: Check compliance with financial rules and help rectify errors before external audit. Internal Audit conducted by the education department serves as an internal control mechanism.
